strings.在熔盐或水溶液中以电流驱动氧化还原反应。与化工厂共用一套结构，但槽体通了电极，能: Drives redox reactions with electric current in molten salts or aqueous solution. Shares its frame with the Chemical Plant, but the vessel is fitted with electrodes, letting it run electrochemical recipes a Chemical Plant cannot.
strings.把氧化与还原两个半反应拆到同一台设备的两侧槽体里分别控温控压。和化工厂同源，但配: Splits the oxidation and reduction half-reactions into two vessels with independent temperature and pressure control. Derived from the Chemical Plant, but with separate oxidant and reductant feed loops, letting it run redox recipes a Chemical Plant cannot.
strings.同时停泊行星内物流运输机与星际物流运输船的大型枢纽。机库与泊位都做了扩容，一座顶: A large hub that berths Logistics Drones and Logistics Vessels at the same time. Both the hangar and the docks are enlarged, so one hub does the work of several stations.
strings.以钴酸锂为正极、石墨为负极的锂离子储能阵列。锂离子在两极之间往返，充得快、存得多: A lithium-ion storage array with a lithium cobalt oxide cathode and a graphite anode. Lithium ions shuttle between the electrodes, so it charges fast and holds far more: several times the energy in the same volume, and full in minutes.
strings.充满电的锂离子储能阵列。既能直接放回电网放电，也能塞进机甲当燃料——单块的能量是: A fully charged lithium-ion storage array. It can be discharged straight back into the grid, or loaded into the mecha as fuel. One unit holds six times the energy of a standard full Accumulator.
strings.为锂离子储能阵列配套的充放电站。把空的锂电池蓄电器充满，或者把满的放回电网——吞: The charging station that serves the lithium-ion storage arrays. It fills empty Lithium-Ion Accumulators, or discharges full ones back into the grid, at six times the throughput of a standard Energy Exchanger.
strings.把一千台风力涡轮机整编进同一座塔阵，共用一套变流与并网设备。单机功率不变，胜在密: A thousand wind turbines marshalled into one tower array behind a single converter and grid tie. Per-turbine output is unchanged; the win is density, one footprint doing the work of a thousand, which pays off best on windy planets. Like a single turbine it lives on planetary wind, so on an airless world it is just as motionless an ornament.
strings.碳热还原冶金的尾气。惰性、易压缩，暂时只能封存——直到有人想起来它还能拿去合成点: The off-gas of carbothermic metallurgy. Inert and easy to compress, so for now it can only be stored, until someone remembers it can be synthesised into something.
strings.电解水的阳极产物。助燃、强氧化性，暂时没有下游用途——先存着。: The anode product of water electrolysis. It feeds combustion and oxidises strongly, but has no downstream use yet, so store it.
strings.煤与水蒸气反应得到的合成气组分。剧毒、可燃，更要紧的是它是个万能的碳砖——甲醇、: A component of the syngas made by reacting coal with steam. Highly toxic and flammable, but what matters is that it is a universal carbon brick: methanol, olefins and synthetic oil can all be built from it.
strings.最简单的醇。合成气加氢的产物，也是整条 C1 路线的中转站——氧化成醛、脱水成烯: The simplest alcohol. Made by hydrogenating syngas, and the junction of the whole C1 route: oxidise it to the aldehyde, dehydrate it to the olefin, and the two branches part here.
strings.甲醇部分氧化的产物，最简单的醛。活性极高，是树脂与粘合剂的骨架单元。: The partial oxidation product of methanol, and the simplest aldehyde. Extremely reactive, and the backbone unit of resins and adhesives.
strings.最简单的烯烃，碳碳双键让它见谁跟谁反应。甲醇制烯烃（MTO）绕开了石油，直接从煤: The simplest olefin; its carbon-carbon double bond reacts with almost anything it meets. Methanol-to-olefins routes around petroleum entirely, building polymer feedstock straight from coal and water.
strings.锂辉石经硫酸焙烧后浸出得到的可溶锂盐。锂从硅酸盐骨架里被换了出来，接下来只剩把它: The soluble lithium salt leached out after roasting spodumene with sulfuric acid. The lithium has been displaced from the silicate framework; all that remains is to part it from the sulfate.
strings.强碱性的白色晶体。既是锂电池正极材料的直接前体，也是熔盐电解制取金属锂的原料。: Strongly alkaline white crystals. Both the direct precursor of lithium battery cathode material and the feedstock for winning lithium metal by molten-salt electrolysis.
strings.层状氧化物，锂离子电池的经典正极。锂离子能在钴氧层之间可逆地进出，充放电上千次而: A layered oxide, the classic lithium-ion cathode. Lithium ions move reversibly in and out between the cobalt-oxygen layers, thousands of cycles without the structure collapsing. That is the whole secret of the lithium battery.
strings.空气里最多的东西，也是最难反应的东西之一。N≡N 三键极其牢固，所以它既不燃烧也: The most abundant thing in air, and one of the least reactive. The N≡N triple bond is extraordinarily strong, so nitrogen neither burns nor feeds combustion, which is exactly why it is used as a protective atmosphere.
strings.把空气里那份最难动的氮变成能用的形态。哈伯法一出现，人类第一次能凭空造出氮肥——: Turns the most immovable nitrogen in the air into a usable form. With the Haber process, humanity could make nitrogen fertiliser out of thin air for the first time, and explosives out of thin air for the first time too.
strings.红棕色的刺鼻气体，氮上带着一个单电子，所以分子是弯的而不是直的。强氧化性，见水即: A reddish-brown, acrid gas. The nitrogen carries an unpaired electron, so the molecule is bent rather than straight. Strongly oxidising, and it becomes acid on contact with water.
strings.三大强酸之一，也是最能氧化的那个。硝化反应的必需品——从化肥到炸药，凡是要往分子: One of the three strong acids, and the most oxidising of them. Indispensable to nitration: from fertiliser to explosives, anything that needs a nitro group hung on a molecule goes through it.
strings.柠檬黄的粉末，钨冶金的通用中间体。它本身极稳定，要把钨从中夺出来，只有氢做得到。: A lemon-yellow powder, the universal intermediate of tungsten metallurgy. It is extremely stable; only hydrogen can wrest the tungsten out of it.
strings.硬度仅次于金刚石的陶瓷，却能导电。极硬、极脆、熔点近 2900°C——单独用会崩: A ceramic second only to diamond in hardness, and yet electrically conductive. Extremely hard, extremely brittle, melting near 2900°C. On its own it shatters; it only becomes a tool once a metal binds it together.
strings.水钴矿，钴的氧化物矿石。以煤为还原剂碳热还原即得金属钴。: Heterogenite, an oxide ore of cobalt. Carbothermic reduction with coal yields cobalt metal directly.
strings.银灰泛蓝的铁磁性金属。高温合金与硬质合金的关键组元。: A ferromagnetic metal, silver-grey with a blue cast. A key constituent of superalloys and cemented carbides.
strings.铝土矿，主要成分为三氧化二铝（Al₂O₃）。碳热还原或电解均可炼出金属铝。: Bauxite, principally aluminium oxide (Al₂O₃). Either carbothermic reduction or electrolysis will win aluminium metal from it.
strings.银白色轻金属，密度只有铁的三分之一，导电性仅次于铜银。: A silvery-white light metal, one third the density of iron, and third only to copper and silver in conductivity.
strings.二水硫酸钙（CaSO₄·2H₂O）。以煤为还原剂高温分解，硫以二氧化硫逸出，钙留: Calcium sulfate dihydrate (CaSO₄·2H₂O). Decomposed at high temperature with coal as the reductant: the sulfur leaves as sulfur dioxide, the calcium stays in the slag.
strings.含锂的铝硅酸盐矿物（LiAlSi₂O₆），硬岩提锂的主矿源。锂被锁在硅酸盐骨架里: A lithium aluminium silicate mineral (LiAlSi₂O₆), the main source of hard-rock lithium. The lithium is locked inside the silicate framework and must first be displaced with sulfuric acid.
strings.密度最小的金属，软到能用小刀切开。极其活泼，在空气里很快失去光泽——正是这种活泼: The least dense metal, soft enough to cut with a knife. So reactive that it tarnishes quickly in air, and it is exactly that reactivity that makes it the first choice for batteries.
strings.软锰矿，主要成分二氧化锰（MnO₂）。黑得发乌，碳热还原即得金属锰——冶金里最不: Pyrolusite, principally manganese dioxide (MnO₂). Dull black; carbothermic reduction yields manganese metal. The least conspicuous and least dispensable metal in metallurgy.
strings.银白偏灰的硬脆金属。极少单独使用，但掺进钢里能同时提高硬度和韧性——锰钢是所有需: A hard, brittle metal, greyish silver-white. Almost never used alone, but added to steel it raises hardness and toughness at once. Manganese steel is the default answer anywhere wear has to be resisted.
strings.铁与铬的复合氧化物（FeCr₂O₄）。黑褐色、带弱磁性，是地球上唯一有工业价值的: A mixed oxide of iron and chromium (FeCr₂O₄). Brownish black and weakly magnetic, it is the only chromium ore of industrial value on Earth. Every piece of stainless steel starts here.
strings.极硬、极亮、极耐腐蚀。掺进钢里就是不锈钢——表面那层氧化膜厚不过几个原子，却能挡: Extremely hard, extremely bright, extremely corrosion resistant. Added to steel it makes stainless steel, and the oxide film on its surface is only a few atoms thick yet holds back acid.
strings.钒、钛、铁共生的黑色磁铁矿。钒在其中只占百分之几，却是它唯一值得开采的理由——没: A black magnetite in which vanadium, titanium and iron occur together. The vanadium is only a few percent of it and is the only reason to mine it: without vanadium there are no alloys that survive heat and pressure.
strings.银白泛蓝的稀有金属。少量掺入就能让钢在高温下不软、在冲击下不裂——所有要求「别坏: A rare metal, silver-white with a blue cast. A small addition keeps steel from softening when hot and from cracking under impact. Everywhere that demands "do not fail" depends on it.
strings.钨酸钙（CaWO₄），半透明的浅黄晶体，紫外光下发亮蓝色荧光。钨在地壳里的丰度只: Calcium tungstate (CaWO₄), translucent pale-yellow crystals that fluoresce bright blue under ultraviolet light. Tungsten makes up only about one part per million of the crust; it forms ore at all only because it concentrates where granite meets limestone.
strings.熔点 3422°C，所有金属里最高；密度和黄金相当，室温下却脆得像玻璃。它的价值: Melting at 3422°C, the highest of any metal; as dense as gold, yet at room temperature as brittle as glass. Its value is not that it is easy to work with, but that nothing else survives that temperature.
strings.以煤为还原剂还原水钴矿。: Reduces heterogenite with coal as the reductant.
strings.通入一氧化碳还原钴矿。气固反应比固固接触充分得多，不用把矿和煤磨到一起。: Reduces cobalt ore in a stream of carbon monoxide. A gas-solid reaction makes far better contact than solid against solid, so the ore and the coal need not be ground together.
strings.以甲醛作还原剂。醛基活性高，比一氧化碳更容易夺氧，一份能多还原一倍的矿。: Uses formaldehyde as the reductant. The aldehyde group is highly reactive and takes oxygen more readily than carbon monoxide, so one unit reduces twice as much ore.
strings.以甲醇作还原剂。碳和氢一起参与夺氧，一份甲醇能还原三份矿，是几条路线里最省还原剂: Uses methanol as the reductant. Carbon and hydrogen both take oxygen, so one unit of methanol reduces three of ore, the thriftiest of these routes.
strings.以乙烯作还原剂。两个碳都还没被氧化过，一份能吃掉六份矿的氧——单位还原剂的产出最: Uses ethylene as the reductant. Neither carbon has been oxidised yet, so one unit takes the oxygen from six of ore: the highest yield per unit of reductant, at the price of ethylene not being cheap.
strings.在氨分解气里还原钴矿。氢夺走氧、氮原样吐回来——这是几条钴路线里唯一不排碳的。: Reduces cobalt ore in cracked ammonia. The hydrogen takes the oxygen and the nitrogen comes back out unchanged: the only one of these cobalt routes that emits no carbon.
strings.以煤为还原剂碳热还原铝土矿。工艺简单、吃煤，尾气是二氧化碳。: Carbothermic reduction of bauxite with coal. Simple, coal-hungry, and it gives off carbon dioxide.
strings.在熔盐电解槽中以氢为还原剂电解氧化铝。不排碳，代价是吃氢，副产水。: Electrolyses alumina in a molten-salt cell with hydrogen as the reductant. No carbon emitted; the price is hydrogen consumed and water as a by-product.
strings.乙烯在高温下先裂解成碳和氢，碳把氧化铝还原成金属铝。碳只被夺走一个氧，出来的是一: Ethylene first cracks at high temperature into carbon and hydrogen, and the carbon reduces alumina to aluminium metal. The carbon loses only one oxygen, so what comes out is carbon monoxide rather than carbon dioxide, and together with the hydrogen that is syngas: the skeleton of the reductant returns to the production line.
strings.以煤为还原剂高温分解石膏，硫以二氧化硫逸出后经催化氧化与吸收得硫酸，钙则留在渣里: Decomposes gypsum at high temperature with coal as the reductant. The sulfur leaves as sulfur dioxide and becomes sulfuric acid after catalytic oxidation and absorption, while the calcium stays in the slag as stone.
strings.锂辉石先高温相变再与硫酸焙烧，锂以硫酸锂的形式被置换出来，剩下的铝硅酸盐骨架成了: Spodumene is first converted by a high-temperature phase change, then roasted with sulfuric acid. The lithium is displaced as lithium sulfate and the remaining aluminosilicate framework becomes tailings.
strings.在双极膜电解槽里把硫酸锂拆开：锂侧出氢氧化锂，酸侧出硫酸。硫酸是循环用的，整条链: Splits lithium sulfate in a bipolar membrane cell: lithium hydroxide on the lithium side, sulfuric acid on the acid side. The acid circulates, so the whole chain needs only one batch to start it.
strings.熔融氢氧化锂通直流电，阴极析出金属锂、阳极放氧。锂太活泼，除了电解没有别的办法把: Direct current through molten lithium hydroxide deposits lithium metal at the cathode and releases oxygen at the anode. Lithium is far too reactive to be won from its compounds by anything but electrolysis.
strings.以煤为还原剂还原软锰矿。锰的氧化物比铁的难还原一些，但远没到铝那种地步。: Reduces pyrolusite with coal as the reductant. Manganese oxides are somewhat harder to reduce than iron's, but nowhere near as hard as aluminium's.
strings.乙烯高温裂解出碳，碳把锰从氧化物里还原出来。比煤多一步，好处是顺带把氢变成了水而: Ethylene cracks at high temperature to give carbon, and the carbon reduces manganese out of its oxide. One step more than coal, and in exchange the hydrogen becomes water instead of being vented for nothing.
strings.以煤在电弧炉里还原铬铁矿。铁和铬一起被还原出来，尾气是一氧化碳而不是二氧化碳——: Reduces chromite with coal in an electric arc furnace. Iron and chromium come out together, and the off-gas is carbon monoxide rather than carbon dioxide, because the carbon loses only one oxygen.
strings.以乙烯裂解出的碳还原铬铁矿。铁和铬一起出来，碳只被夺走一个氧，尾气仍是一氧化碳。: Reduces chromite with carbon cracked out of ethylene. Iron and chromium come out together, the carbon loses only one oxygen, and the off-gas is still carbon monoxide.
strings.以金属铝还原钒的氧化物。铝夺氧的能力比碳强得多，这正是碳还原不动的那些氧化物的通: Reduces vanadium oxide with aluminium metal. Aluminium takes oxygen far more strongly than carbon does, which is the general answer for the oxides carbon cannot move.
strings.从精炼油的重质残渣里焙烧浸出。钒在其中是百万分之几的杂质，攒够一块要烧掉极多的油: Roasted and leached out of the heavy residue of refined oil. The vanadium there is an impurity of a few parts per million, so one ingot burns an enormous amount of oil, but at least it does not require waiting for a vanadium planet.
strings.用硫酸把钨从钨酸钙里换出来，沉淀成钨酸后煅烧成三氧化钨。钙以石膏的形式留在渣里。: Sulfuric acid displaces the tungsten from calcium tungstate; it precipitates as tungstic acid and is calcined to the trioxide. The calcium stays in the residue as gypsum.
strings.在氢气流中还原三氧化钨，得到钨粉。钨是极少数只能靠氢冶炼的金属——碳一插手，得到: Reduces tungsten trioxide in a stream of hydrogen to give tungsten powder. Tungsten is one of the very few metals that can only be smelted with hydrogen: the moment carbon is involved, what you get is the carbide, not the metal.
strings.钨粉与炭黑在高温下渗碳。这是碳唯一能对钨做成的事——也正是它炼不出金属钨的原因。: Tungsten powder and carbon black carburised at high temperature. This is the one thing carbon can do to tungsten, and precisely why it cannot smelt tungsten metal.
strings.在电解槽中通直流电分解水，阴极出氢、阳极出氧。是获取清洁氢的基础工艺，代价是电。: Direct current through a cell splits water, hydrogen at the cathode and oxygen at the anode. The basic route to clean hydrogen, paid for in electricity.
strings.赤热的碳与水蒸气反应，得到一氧化碳与氢的混合气。工业上叫合成气，是煤化工整条路线: Red-hot carbon reacts with steam to give a mixture of carbon monoxide and hydrogen. Industry calls it syngas, and it is the doorway to the whole coal chemistry route.
strings.合成气在铜基催化剂上加压加氢。碳被还原、氢被氧化，一步做到甲醇。: Syngas hydrogenated under pressure over a copper-based catalyst. The carbon is reduced and the hydrogen oxidised, reaching methanol in one step.
strings.直接拿二氧化碳加氢。比合成气路线多吃一份氢、多排一份水，好处是把碳热还原冶金的尾: Hydrogenates carbon dioxide directly. It costs one more unit of hydrogen and gives off one more of water than the syngas route, and in exchange it plugs the off-gas of carbothermic metallurgy back into the production line.
strings.甲醇在银催化剂上部分氧化脱氢。控制得住就停在醛，控制不住就一路烧到二氧化碳。: Methanol partially oxidised and dehydrogenated over a silver catalyst. Keep it under control and it stops at the aldehyde; lose control and it burns all the way to carbon dioxide.
strings.甲醇在分子筛上脱水成烯。碳的价态从头到尾没变，只是把水赶了出去——所以这一步归化: Methanol dehydrated to the olefin over a molecular sieve. The oxidation state of the carbon never changes; only water is driven off, which is why this step belongs to the Chemical Plant and not the Redox Chemical Plant.
strings.合成气在铁钴催化剂上聚合成链状烃。二战和禁运年代的救命工艺——只要有煤和水，就能: Syngas polymerised into chain hydrocarbons over an iron-cobalt catalyst. The process that saved the day in wartime and under embargo: given coal and water, you can make oil.
strings.氢氧化锂与钴在氧气氛中高温固相合成层状氧化物。锂和钴这两种矿在这里第一次汇到一起: Lithium hydroxide and cobalt combined in the solid state at high temperature under oxygen to give the layered oxide. This is where the lithium and cobalt ores meet for the first time.
strings.高压下让氮气与氢在铁催化剂上化合。氮气那道三键极难拆开，正因如此这一步在二十世纪: Nitrogen and hydrogen combined over an iron catalyst under high pressure. That nitrogen triple bond is extremely hard to break, which is why this step was considered impossible at the start of the twentieth century.
strings.氨在铂网上被氧气烧掉，氮一路氧化到二氧化氮。反应剧烈放热，靠的就是氨里那个 −3: Ammonia burned with oxygen over platinum gauze, the nitrogen oxidised all the way to nitrogen dioxide. The reaction is violently exothermic, driven by just how badly the −3 nitrogen in ammonia wants to be oxidised.
strings.二氧化氮在吸收塔里被水吸收，同时补入空气把中间产物一并氧化。氮走到 +5 价，到: Nitrogen dioxide absorbed by water in an absorption tower, with air fed in to oxidise the intermediates as well. The nitrogen reaches +5, and that is as far as it goes.
strings.碳化钨与钴粉压坯后高温烧结。钴的比例决定牌号：钴越少越硬越脆，钴越多越韧越钝。: Tungsten carbide and cobalt powder pressed and sintered at high temperature. The cobalt fraction sets the grade: less cobalt is harder and more brittle, more cobalt is tougher and blunter.
strings.以X射线轰击原油分子，使其裂解为精炼油与氢。产出与等离子精炼相同，但可在化工设备: Bombards crude oil molecules with X-rays to crack them into refined oil and hydrogen. The yield matches plasma refining, but it can be run in chemical facilities.
strings.碳化钨颗粒由金属钴液相烧结粘结而成。钴越多越韧越钝，钴越少越硬越脆——它不是一种: Tungsten carbide grains bound by liquid-phase sintered cobalt. More cobalt is tougher and blunter, less cobalt is harder and more brittle: it is not one material but a continuous composition line. The ratio is set in the panel below the smelter window: the four properties follow the ratio, and a better ratio buys more output and a shorter cycle, at the price of more rare metal per batch.
strings.高锰钢。含锰约 12%，平时并不算硬，一旦受到冲击表面立刻加工硬化——越砸越耐砸: Hadfield steel, around 12% manganese. Not especially hard at rest, but the surface work-hardens the instant it is struck: the more it is hammered, the better it takes hammering. The ratio is set in the panel below the smelter window: the four properties follow the ratio, and a better ratio buys more output and a shorter cycle, at the price of more rare metal per batch.
strings.铬在表面自发形成一层致密的钝化膜，划破了还会自己长回去——这才是它不锈的原因，不: Chromium forms a dense passive film on the surface all by itself, and grows it back when scratched. That is why it does not rust, not because chromium itself cannot corrode. The ratio is set in the panel below the smelter window: the four properties follow the ratio, and a better ratio buys more output and a shorter cycle, at the price of more rare metal per batch.

strings.藻油与甲醇在碱催化下互换酯基，三条脂肪酸链逐条被甲醇换下来，得到脂肪酸甲酯——也: Algal oil and methanol swap ester groups over a base catalyst; the three fatty-acid chains come off one by one and leave as fatty-acid methyl esters — biodiesel, in other words. The glycerol by-product stays at the bottom of the vessel. This is what connects the whole algal line to the existing petrochemical downstream.
strings.巨型生化培养舱，速度 10000 倍。穹顶下是恒温恒湿的人工雨林，光合育林、藻菌: A mega bioculture vessel running at 10000x speed. Under the dome sits a climate-controlled artificial rainforest where all three steps — photosynthetic forestry, algal-bacterial co-culture and solvent extraction — are carried out. The forestry step is bound to sunlight: once the sun drops below the horizon it stops. Twelve belt ports connect directly, so neither input nor output needs a sorter, and it carries its own planetary logistics station.
strings.微藻与异养细菌的共培养生物量。藻固碳产油，菌分解藻的渗出物、把氮磷还给藻——两者: Biomass from a co-culture of microalgae and heterotrophic bacteria. The algae fix carbon and make oil; the bacteria break down what the algae exude and hand the nitrogen and phosphorus back — together they grow faster than either does alone. Centrifuged, it is a dark green wet cake with the oil still locked inside the cells.
strings.从藻细胞里榨出来的甘油三酯，工业上叫单细胞油脂。成分和植物油是一类东西，差别只在: Triglycerides pressed out of algal cells — single-cell oil, as industry calls it. Chemically it is the same family as vegetable oil; the difference is that it grows in a tank rather than a field, taking no farmland and waiting on no season, needing only light, nitrogen and phosphorus.
strings.穹顶下的人工雨林。恒温恒湿、二氧化碳加富，生长速度是野地里的几十倍，代价是整座棚: An artificial rainforest under the dome. Climate-controlled and CO₂-enriched, it grows dozens of times faster than open ground — at the price that the whole house is lit by the star alone. Once the sun drops below the horizon, work stops.
strings.把木料和草料打成浆，连同水一起送进曝气罐。藻靠光长、菌吃藻的渗出物，两者的氮磷在: Wood and plant matter are pulped and fed into an aerated tank along with water. The algae live on light, the bacteria on what the algae exude, and their nitrogen and phosphorus cycle inside the vessel — far faster than algae alone. The oxygen is for the bacteria to respire; the offgas is carbon dioxide.
strings.先高压破壁，再用溶剂把细胞里的甘油三酯洗出来，蒸掉溶剂剩下的就是藻油。脱脂后的藻: High-pressure homogenisation breaks the cell walls, then a solvent washes the triglycerides out; boil the solvent off and what remains is algal oil. The defatted residue is discarded here as waste.
